transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling from your care team. May I please speak with Rahul? This call is about a healthcare follow-up.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Rahul. I have your health results here. Your fasting blood glucose reading from October 1, 2026 was 180 milligrams per deciliter. That is well above the commonly used reference range for fasting blood glucose, which is 70 to 99 milligrams per deciliter. Do you have any questions about this result?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That sounds concerning. I would like to see a doctor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand your concern. Before we book, I want to share one more result with you. Your HbA1c reading from October 1, 2026 was 8.2 percent. HbA1c reflects your average blood sugar over roughly the past three months. That is well above the commonly used reference range for HbA1c, which is below 5.7 percent. A doctor can review these results with you and help explain what they mean. Would you like me to help you book a consultation?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, please help me book a consultation.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I have some available times for you to see a doctor. Would Monday, October 12 at 9:30 AM, 11 AM, or 2 PM work for you?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Monday, October 12 at 9:30 AM works for me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: To confirm, you would like to book the consultation for Monday, October 12 at 9:30 AM. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Your appointment is booked for Monday, October 12 at 9:30 AM. Thank you for your time today, Rahul. Goodbye!
